name: ECON 2411
title: Money and Banking
description: The nature of money, the origins of monetary standards and systems, the development and operation of commercial banking, the Federal Reserve System, and international monetary agencies.
requirement_description: ECON 1200 or both ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150) and ECON 1202; ECON 1201 (or ARE 1150) may be taken concurrently.
